card.line: Tishbe was the town linked to Elijah the Tishbite, the prophet who told King Ahab that no rain would fall except at his word.

moments.title: Elijah the Tishbite
moments.text: Elijah is called the Tishbite, a name tied to Tishbe, and he is described as among the settlers of Gilead. He tells King Ahab that no dew or rain will fall except at his word.
